title: Susu Box or Piggy Bank: Assessing Cultural Commonsense Knowledge between Ghana and the U.S.

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on a custom multiple-choice dataset (AMAMMERE) of commonsense questions to measure models' preferences for U.S.-centric versus Ghana-centric answers in culturally unspecified contexts, and assessing their accuracy when explicit cultural cues are provided.
